in_sanskrit.name: सुकन्त
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The nameु prefix in Sukant implies goodness and happiness. The rootकन्त means to press or to hold. So Sukant can be interpreted as 'One who holds or presses happiness or goodness.'

in_hindi.name: सुकन्त
in_hindi.long_meaning: Sukant's Hindi name is the same as its Sanskrit counterpart. It translates to 'Good, Happy, Auspicious'.

in_tamil.name: ஸுகந்த
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, Sukant translates to 'Abhiramkam, Periya Arambam'. The prefix 'A' in Abhiramkam signifies 'great' or 'big'. Arambam means 'beginning' or 'start'. So Sukant can be interpreted as 'Great Beginning' or 'Big Start'.

in_telugu.name: సుకన్త
in_telugu.long_meaning: Sukant's Telugu name is also the same as its Sanskrit and Hindi counterparts. It translates to 'Aashishya, Shubh'. Aashishya means 'one who is worthy of love and respect'. Shubh means 'auspicious' or 'blessings'.

in_marathi.name: Sukant
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Good, Pleasant, Happiness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sukant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sukant is derived from the Sanskrit word 'suk' which means good, pleasant, happiness and 'kant' which means doer. The name implies a person who brings happiness and positivity to those around him.

The name implies a person who brings happiness and positivity to those around him.
